label: obligate syntrophy interaction
definition: A syntrophy interaction in which neither partner grows in the absence of the other, because the metabolism each performs is thermodynamically infeasible without the other removing its product.
observations: Distinguished from the facultative case by a monoculture control: if the source grows either partner alone, the pairing is not obligate.

label: facultative syntrophy interaction
definition: A syntrophy interaction in which the partners exchange metabolites to mutual advantage but each is also able to grow alone.
observations: The common case in defined cocultures. CommunityMech:000336 is the worked example: every source calls the C. acetobutylicum-C. ljungdahlii pairing a syntrophy, and the seed paper grows both species as monocultures in the same experiment.

label: material transfer interaction
definition: An ecological interaction classified by what moves between the partners rather than by which of them benefits. Sibling of the sign-based types, not a subtype of them.
observations: The gap this cohort exists to fill. InteractionTypeEnum classifies by sign (+/+, +/0, -/-), so a transfer whose benefit is unestablished has no home and curators either assert an unearned sign or leave the type unset.

label: interspecies cell fusion
definition: A material transfer interaction in which two organisms of different species join their cell walls and membranes, producing a shared cytoplasmic compartment.
observations: GO:0140253 cell-cell fusion is a biological process, not an inter-organism relation, so it can fill biological_processes and cannot fill interaction_type. Demonstrated structurally for Clostridium acetobutylicum and C. ljungdahlii in PMID:32873766.

label: interspecies cytoplasmic material exchange
definition: A material transfer interaction in which macromolecules - protein, RNA, ribosomes - pass between organisms of different species. Distinct from metabolite cross-feeding, whose currency is small molecules.
observations: Reported for the C. acetobutylicum-C. ljungdahlii pairing in PMID:32873766 and PMID:39254339. Bidirectional, so it has no natural source or target.

label: interspecies horizontal gene transfer
definition: A material transfer interaction in which genetic material passes from one species to another and is retained by the recipient.
observations: Wanted as a type in its own right so the mechanism can be qualified: fusion-mediated transfer (PMID:38214507) is distinct from conjugation, transduction and transformation, and the distinction is the finding in that paper.

label: interspecies electron transfer
definition: A material transfer interaction in which electrons pass from one organism to another, whether through a diffusible carrier such as hydrogen or formate, or directly.
observations: GO has no term for this. Searching EBI OLS for 'extracellular electron transport' and 'interspecies electron transfer' returns nothing, and every GO electron-transport-chain term denotes an intracellular series of complexes. METPO:1000805 Electron transfer is xrefed to GO:0009055, which is a molecular function.

label: direct interspecies electron transfer
definition: An interspecies electron transfer in which electrons pass through a physical conductive connection - conductive pili, cytochromes, or a conductive mineral - rather than through a diffusible carrier.
observations: Twelve CommunityMech interactions were annotated GO:0009055 electron transfer activity, a molecular function, for want of this class; #751 removed those annotations rather than substitute a term that means something else.
